name: NGC 4848 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4848, a barred spiral galaxy in the Coma Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4848-hubble
story: Speeding through the hot gas of the Coma Cluster, this barred spiral is having its own gas swept away by ram pressure. Hubble picks out the faint, wispy tails of its outer arms, giving it a ghostly look.

claims.text: NGC 4848 is a barred spiral (SBab) galaxy
NGC 4848 is a spiral galaxy in the Coma cluster
It is suffering ram pressure from its high-velocity motion through the cluster gas
Hubble shows faint wispy tails of the outer arms and a ghost-like appearance
